description: Capless provides headless web analytics, session replay, and OpenTelemetry-based agent traces on top of append-only streams, CEL filtering, and ClickHouse materializations. It is designed so websites, apps, and coding agents can install tracking, read event data, and query analytics programmatically.
summary: Capless exposes a bearer-authenticated REST API at `api.capless.sh/v1`, a public signup API and public `/new` snippet generator, an OTLP/HTTP ingest endpoint, and an OAuth- or API-key-protected remote MCP server at `mcp.capless.sh/mcp`.
